description: This file implements serialization and deserialization logic for WebSocket HTTP requests and responses, including handling of headers, content types, encoding, chunked transfer, and related WebSocket headers. It defines classes and methods for serializing HTTP messages and parsing incoming streams, with support for compression and various HTTP/WebSocket features.

classes.name: Request
classes.description: Represents an HTTP/WebSocket request with methods for serialization and deserialization, including handling of headers, body, and various request parameters.

classes.name: Response
classes.description: Represents an HTTP response with methods for serialization and deserialization, including headers, status, and body.

methods.name: Serialize
methods.description: Serializes the request or response object into a stream buffer, handling headers, body, and protocol specifics.

methods.name: Deserialize
methods.description: Parses incoming stream data to populate request or response objects, handling headers, chunked transfer, and content decoding.

methods.name: ParseContentType
methods.description: Parses the Content-Type header to extract MIME type and character set.

methods.name: ToSignature
methods.description: Converts a signature object into a string representation.

methods.name: FromSignature
methods.description: Converts a string into a signature object.

methods.name: ToAuthorization
methods.description: Parses an authorization header string into an Authorization object.

methods.name: FromAuthorization
methods.description: Converts an Authorization object into a string suitable for headers.

methods.name: MIMETypeForFile
methods.description: Determines the MIME type based on a file extension in a given path.
